page.layout: One printed page: a single full-page engraving (crucifixion scene with landscape and town) in the centre; a blue library stamp at the lower right, not transcribed.
page.notes: The page carries only an engraving of the crucified Christ with a landscape and walled town behind; it shows no printed text. The blue circular stamp reading "BIBLIOTECA ... NAPOLI" at the lower right is a library stamp and is not transcribed.
